messages:
maria: quick question — we're planning to ship app logs to our analytics pipeline and Sentry. some log lines include user emails and small chat snippets. is storing those raw values OK? what classification does that fall under and do we need approvals before sending to a third-party vendor?
allen: emails are PII -> classify as 'sensitive (PII)'. raw emails should not be sent to external analytics or vendors. you need to redact or pseudonymize before export. also avoid sending full chat transcripts unless consented. :warning:
sophia: fwiw screenshots in product channels — if they show emails or messages, treat them like PII too and redact before posting.
devon: for local/dev debugging, is it ok to keep raw emails in dev logs?
allen: dev envs should use synthetic/test users. if you absolutely need prod data in dev, get temporary access and record justification + retention. rotate creds and delete copies after use.
allen: practical scrubber examples — simple sed for pipeline:
```
sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/[REDACTED_EMAIL]/g'
```
node/Sentry before_send example:
```js
function beforeSend(event) {
  if (event.user && event.user.email) {
    event.user.email = hash(event.user.email); // or redact
  }
  return event;
}
```
security-bot: policy note: see log redaction guide — <https://intranet.company/log-redaction> and Data Classification matrix <https://intranet.company/data-classification>. PII requires either redaction, pseudonymization, or explicit data-sharing approval.
sre-bot: if you plan to share logs with an external vendor, open a ticket in #vendor-requests and attach the Data Sharing Assessment. also set retention <= 30 days unless legal approves. :memo:
maria: thanks — i'll add the scrubber to the pipeline and update the Sentry before_send.
maria: + i'll open a vendor-requests ticket with sample lines and justification if we need to share trimmed logs.
devon: quick follow-up — any recommended hashing approach? deterministic so we can join?
allen: deterministic hash OK if salted and access-bounded. use HMAC with a service key stored in KMS: `hmac_sha256(kms_key, email)` — log the hash only, not the key.
sophia: also remember to remove screenshots/screenshare clips from public channels. internal-only ok but still redact.
maria: got it, thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
